scripts.start: mkdir -p /app/.openclaw/agents/main/agent && node -e "const k=process.env.FLOCK_API_KEY; const obj={'token':k,'key':k}; const c=JSON.stringify({'flock':obj,'flock:manual':obj,'flock-ai':obj,'openai':obj}); require('fs').writeFileSync('/app/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json', c); require('fs').writeFileSync('/app/.openclaw/auth-profiles.json', c); console.log('Auth provisioned');" && openclaw gateway --allow-unconfigured --bind auto
